title: AI 问询首页 T6: hide the `ai:chat` menu entry from people who cannot get an agent (no AI or no seat); the app home falls through to the next entry
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cwGVgec21LwQTtRY85

Filing gate: ③ maintainer-directed task. Source: maintainer — the AI 问询首页 plan ordered 「立卡派发」 (2026-11-27 02:37Z, quoted in #37788's body), handed to seat repo:objectstack#1 by epic:#5027#1 (mailbox comment 7209013967) and taken on Elon's tap 「全接,开新专区」 (accepted 7210179549). Scope rows: #37788 comment 7210202110 (Fable review §4, copied verbatim by hotlong).
Grading: area:ai · Feature · priority:p2 · size S · reach: every app with an `ai:chat` entry, opened by someone the deployment or their seat gives no agent.
Dedupe: open-issue search `ai:chat hide seat`: 3 hits (#37788 #37819 #6015, none a hide rule); `"useAiSurface" navigation`: 1 hit (#37788).
Blocked-by: #37788

## 维护者速读
- 是什么：拿不到 AI 的人（部署没开 AI，或本人没有席位）在菜单里看不到「AI 问询」项；如果它本来是首页，首页顺延到下一个菜单项，而不是打开一个「不可用」页面。
- 为什么等 #37788：要隐藏的就是 #37788 做的那个页面。
- 要你做什么：无。

## Scope (from #37788 comment 7210202110; `AS` = `ui/packages/app-shell/src`)
- Someone who cannot get the agent does not see the `ai:chat` item (component ref `AI_CHAT_COMPONENT_REF` from `@objectstack/spec/ui`), and the app's home falls to the next nav item instead of an unavailable page.

## Evidence (read at objectstack `da31daff`; re-measure at claim)
- AI entry points judge per person ("can this person get an agent"), not per deployment (`AS/hooks/useAiSurface.ts:79-97`).
- `requiresService` (`packages/spec/src/ui/app.zod.ts:451`) covers deployment level only; no existing per-seat hide mechanism was found. Confirm at implementation; if the fix needs a new spec key, stop and report (a new key is its own card).

## Acceptance
- One case on the community edition (no AI) and one for an account without a seat: the entry is absent and the home is the next entry.
- #37788's `AiUnavailable` state still covers a direct link to the page.
